## A quantitative foundation. A practical focus.

I’m drawn to problems people encounter in everyday work: repetitive tasks, difficult processes, and information that needs to be clearer. My projects combine analysis, workflow improvement, and reusable tools with guidance that helps people use them.

**Tools:** Python · Pandas · NumPy · SQL/MySQL · Excel · Stata · EViews · R

[More about my background](about.qmd){.project-link}
:::

## What I can bring to your team

The projects here reflect the approach I would bring to your organisation: understand the problem, work carefully with the evidence, and build a solution that people can use.

- **Practical problem-solving:** identify where a process is slow, confusing, or difficult to use, then break it into manageable steps.
- **Data Science and research support:** source and prepare data, check its quality, investigate questions, and explain findings with their limitations.
- **Useful tools and workflows:** turn repeated tasks into clearer, reusable processes, with documentation that helps others use and maintain them.

My economic data pipeline, reusable portfolio framework, and sales reconciliation work show how I apply that approach to different needs. I want to bring the same curiosity, care, and willingness to improve to your team’s data, platforms, and everyday operations.

I’m ready to learn your systems, take feedback, and put consistent effort into the responsibilities I’m given. I will ask questions when needed, communicate progress, and follow through on the work. My aim is to contribute useful results while continuing to develop my skills.

I’m open to Data Science, quantitative research, business analysis, and graduate opportunities.
